skills.description: 将用户上传的人像或环境照片重构为受《极乐迪斯科》启发的心理绘画与环境概念作品；首轮说明适配性并等待确认。人像默认使用激进概念肖像，可选温和角色肖像；环境保留地点锚点并进行作者化重构。 / Reconstruct user portraits and environments as Disco Elysium-inspired psychological paintings and concept artwork; explain source fit first, use conceptual portraits by default, and preserve essential place anchors while radically redesigning the rendering.
skills.description_zh: Assess and radically reconstruct a user-supplied portrait, environmental portrait, city, town, village, street, architecture, interior, or natural-landscape photograph as a Disco Elysium-style psychological painting or environmental concept artwork. Use when the user wants authored reconstruction rather than a realistic oil-paint filter. On the first Skill turn for a new photo or batch, explain source-fit limits and wait for confirmation instead of generating. Portraits preserve identity topology while rebuilding the face and distilling the uploaded background into symbolic geometry. Environments preserve essential place anchors while redesigning narrative, atmosphere, palette, depth, edges, and detail with B2.5 creative freedom; pure nature remains a conditional fit.
skills.name: photo-to-disco-elysium
